overview.text: Delia Ramirez has represented Illinois's 3rd Congressional District in the U.S. House since 2023. Before Congress, she served as an Assistant Majority Leader in the Illinois House. Earlier, she was Executive Director of the Center for Changing Lives, a nonprofit, and held roles at Common Cause IL and the Community Renewal Society.
